text: Gomɗii on fennii -onon sirkooɓe ɓen- ɓen ɓe rewuɗon ɗum gaani Alla e ko nodditiɗon kon e hoore maɓɓe, on hattantah riiwtugol Lepte ɗen e wonkiiji mooɗon wanah wallugol ɗi kadi sabu ronkere mooɗon, kala tooñirɗo e mo'on -onon gomɗinɓe ɓen- sirkangol Alla, Men meeɗinay mo Lepte mawɗe yeru ko Men meeɗini ɗe kon ɓe jaŋtaaɓe.
